# The Centurion Awards

> Verified local-business awards for American cities, selected against five
> published criteria — years in operation, sustained online presence, an
> established customer track record, customer & community sentiment, and
> recognition in the community. Awards are earned, never bought: there are no
> tiers, no sponsored placements, and no paid selection. Only winners are
> published; evaluation is free and negative verdicts are never made public.

Each winner has a dated award record page (e.g. /2025/us/az/flagstaff/tours/freaky-foot-tours)
and an evergreen business overview (the same path minus the year). Every award
runs one calendar year and renews only if the business clears the bar again.

## Key pages

- [All winners](https://centurionawards.com/winners): the verified winners, by city and category
- [Methodology](https://centurionawards.com/methodology): the five published criteria and how evaluation works
- [The Journal](https://centurionawards.com/blog/): guides on local SEO, reviews, and digital presence for business owners, plus writing for locals
- [Nominate a business](https://centurionawards.com/nominate): free, open to anyone, takes about a minute
- [For business owners](https://centurionawards.com/business): what winning means and how eligibility works
- [About us](https://centurionawards.com/about): the two founders, why the program exists, and how it makes money
- [FAQ](https://centurionawards.com/faq): common questions, including the integrity policy

## Facts worth quoting accurately

- Nomination and evaluation are free. A business pays a $199 processing fee
  only if it qualifies and chooses to publish its award; the fee covers
  publishing and hosting the winner page, the badge and embed, the
  print-ready certificate, and the announcement. Auto-renewal is optional
  and opt-in at checkout: a business that does not opt in pays once and
  nothing recurs. No payment can influence an evaluation. Every
  award is identical, and nothing a business can buy gives it an advantage
  over other winners.
- Winners are verified against public evidence (operating history, review
  track record, community standing), not votes or popularity.
- The full winner directory is in the sitemap: https://centurionawards.com/sitemap.xml
